title: Garden orb weaver
price_note: free: every low poly model is. The /cdn links need no account and no key (an account adds the ready-to-serve zip). The HD edition, where `hd` is not null, comes with Pro

hd.kind: pbr materials on this same mesh

preview_note: The SKELETON comes with it: this preview carries its skin and its bones, so a clip plays on it as delivered; its normals are stripped for flat shading. This model is free, so build with `download.glb`: the authored file, normals and node names as built.

usdz.for: iOS AR Quick Look, Omniverse; with UsdPhysics collision and mass

usda.for: Isaac Sim, Omniverse, Blender, usdview; with UsdPhysics collision and mass

obj.also_fetch_note: save it beside the .obj as garden-orb-weaver-base.mtl: the model names that exact file and imports white without it

export_note: vertex colours become NAMED MATERIALS on export, named after this asset's own colour knobs; a plain format conversion would arrive white, because only three.js reads our COLOR_0. Built on first request (about a second), cached after. This model is free: these download with no account and no key (only its .mjs source asks for a free account).

real_scale.note: built LARGER than the real thing: its largest dimension is 5.42 m as built, a real one is typically 0.01-0.03 m (an estimate). Scaling the object by about 0 gives real size. size_m, physics and mass_kg describe the model as built; mass goes with the cube of the scale.

physics.note: For the default knob settings; a size knob changes all of it. dimensions_m and the colliders are measured from the model; mass_kg and material are an estimate of what the real object weighs. body "static" means fixed in place (give it a collider, no rigid body); "dynamic" means it moves. collision.approximation uses UsdPhysics terms: "convexHull" = one hull is a good fit, "convexDecomposition" = use the per-part hulls in colliders_url (the one hull would fill a gap, like the space under a table). Model space, metres, Y up, origin as the model ships.

description: Low-poly garden-orb-weaver with editable proportions and authored animations. Animals v2. Built at 4.7 x 1.47 x 5.42 m, 2,942 triangles on one material.
style: low-poly, flat-shaded vertex colors, no textures, single shared material, so any set of these merges to one draw call
origin: ground level (minY = 0): the model sits on y=0 as-is
animation: rigged parts are named groups with the pivot at the hinge/axle: obj.getObjectByName(part) then rotation[axis] (rotate, degrees) or position[axis] (slide, meters). 0 is the pose the model is built in, which is not always shut: `range` is all the travel the part has from there, and outside it the part passes through the body. Whether the range opens or closes is in that knob's describe in params_url
clips_note: inside the .glb and its preview: gltf.animations by these names, played with THREE.AnimationMixer. Not in the .mjs, which builds the model without them.
license: Mesh files (GLB, FBX, USD, OBJ): CC BY 4.0 with the line in `credit`, or the Polyfork licence with no credit and no redistribution, your choice. The .mjs source and the HD edition: Polyfork licence only, commercial use, no attribution, no redistribution. https://polyfork.dev/licensing

access.remix_note: The budget is on generating NEW geometry. Variations anyone has already baked are served to everybody and never counted, so re-fetching a variant you or anyone else has made costs nothing.
access.remix_allowance_note: Anonymous callers are counted per IP address, so other sessions from the same address share this. A free account raises it to 300 a WEEK on its own budget, and costs an email address.

a_free_account_adds.how: Authorization: Bearer <key>, created at https://polyfork.dev/account. Costs an email address.
a_free_account_adds.downloads: every low poly model's .mjs program and a ready-to-serve zip from /dl, and any kit as one zip (/dl/kit-<id>.zip). The .glb, .fbx, .usdz, .usda and .obj need no key

pro_adds.hd_editions: the HD edition of a model: the same program built finer, high poly with PBR materials generated in code, every knob still working. 1,769 models have one. Free accounts get its public preview (/cdn/<id>-hd-preview.glb) only
pro_adds.cdn: a per-account /c/<token>/ path for the HD files you can hotlink from a shipped build; it keeps up when an asset is rebuilt, and the token is not the API key
pro_adds.remix_bakes_per_week: uncapped: a free account gets a weekly allowance, Pro does not
